subject: Request: One-time credit + discounted trial for Igneo Surge partnership pilot
messages:
From: Sofia Lopez <s.lopez@igneo.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@igneo.com>, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot request — Igneo Surge (partner) — ask for credits + discount

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Igneo is excited about Redwood's latency profile for our real-time annotation workload. We discussed running a 6-week pilot across two internal apps (Surge ingest + QA) starting next month.

Quick summary of the ask from our side:
- 60-day trial extension beyond the standard pilot window (so we can cover our end-of-quarter load test)
- $30k in platform credits applied up front against usage
- a partner introductory discount (30% off list tokens) for the first 3 months following pilot conversion

We have a broad NDAs signed and an internal legal contact if you need procurement details. I attached a short scope doc and a usage snapshot so you can see estimated token volumes.

Can Redwood approve the combined credit + discount package as a one-time partner concession? If it helps, Igneo is prepared to commit to a 12-month minimum spend if pilot results meet our latency and cost targets.

Thanks,
Sofia
Sofia Lopez
Director, Platform Partnerships — Igneo Labs
attachments: [Igneo_Pilot_SOW_v1.pdf, igneo-usage-snapshot-20270410.csv]

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot request — Igneo Surge (partner) — ask for credits + discount

Hi Sofia — great to hear and thanks for the docs.

We're keen to run the pilot with Igneo. I want to confirm internal next steps so we can move quickly:
- I'll scope the promotional package and route for approval (this is a combined credits + discount ask and will need an exec sign-off)
- Aditya and I will align on the proposed commercial terms (commit horizon if you convert)
- Naomi, can you weigh in on whether a 60-day extension + $30k credit + 30% introductory discount is within standard partner playbook, or whether we should tighten the ask?

Sofia — expect a follow-up with a mutually actionable term sheet by EOD Tuesday.

Best,
Mateo
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference

Subject: Fwd: Pilot request — Igneo Surge (partner) — ask for credits + discount

Naomi / Mateo — looping Legal (Dev) because Igneo's ask includes an SLA discussion and a partner discount that might touch reserved capacity routing. Quick notes from my side:
- Proposed commercial package: 60-day pilot extension, $30k upfront credit, 30% discount for first 3 months post-conversion; Igneo signals a possible 12-month commit.
- Risk: extended trial + discount on top of credits increases initial unit economics pressure. Recs: tie discount to a minimum conversion ARR ($X) or ramp clause (eg. discount only on first $50k post-conversion).

Can we get an exec decision on whether to approve a one-time partner concession with those guardrails? If yes, nominate signatory and I'll prepare the redline-ready SOW.

Thanks,
Aditya
Head of Growth, Redwood Inference

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot request — Igneo Surge (partner) — ask for credits + discount — approval request

Marissa — asking for your approval on a one-time partner concession for Igneo Labs. Summary and recommendation below: 

Requested package from Igneo:
- 60-day pilot extension (they run a longer end-of-quarter test)
- $30k platform credit applied upfront
- 30% introductory token discount for first 3 months after conversion

Recommended guardrails (to protect unit economics):
1) Apply credit as a usage credit only; non-refundable and expires at end of pilot + 30 days.
2) Discount applies only after conversion and capped to the first $60k of billable tokens; thereafter list pricing.
3) Require a signed 12-month MSA or committed ARR baseline to unlock the discount (simple conversion clause in SOW).
4) No SLA changes in the pilot; any SLA carveouts require a separate operational review. Legal (Dev) to confirm standard language.

Rationale: Igneo is a strategic target in our partnerships funnel with strong co-selling potential; the ask is sizable but recoverable with the conversion commitment and cap on discounted volume.

If you approve, I will instruct Aditya to finalize the SOW and notify the finance team to allocate a one-time promotional budget.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
VP, Growth — Redwood Inference

All — thanks for the clear recommendation. I approve the one-time partner concession under the guardrails Naomi outlined. Specifics to document in the SOW:
- $30k one-time usage credit, expiring at pilot end + 30 days
- 60-day pilot extension to be reflected in timelines
- 30% introductory discount post-conversion, applicable up to the first $60k of billable tokens and contingent on a signed 12-month commitment (MSA) within 30 days of conversion
- No SLA changes for the pilot phase

Dev, please review the SOW for any legal language items and confirm there are no procurement blockers. Aditya / Mateo — proceed to finalize commercial terms with Igneo and share the redline to me for records.

Marissa Cole
Chief Commercial Officer, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
